class.name: SentryCrashReporterOptions
class.brief_description: Configures the crash reporter, which shows a dialog after a crash.
class.description: Contains configuration options for the crash reporter, an external program that the SDK launches after a crash. In its dialog, the player reviews the report, adds a comment, and chooses whether to send it. Access this configuration through [member SentryOptions.crash_reporter]. Configure these options in Project Settings under [b]Sentry > Crash Reporter[/b], or override them in the initialization callback passed to [method SentrySDK.init]. Each [code]sentry/crash_reporter/path_<platform>_<arch>[/code] project setting specifies the reporter executable that export bundles for that target, as a [code]res://[/code] or absolute path. An empty value means no reporter for that target. When the [code]sentry/crash_reporter/enabled[/code] project setting is enabled, export copies the reporter beside the game executable. If you enable the reporter in code instead, export doesn't include it, and you need to bundle it with your game manually. Each SDK release offers the prebuilt [url=https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-desktop-crash-reporter]Sentry Desktop Crash Reporter[/url] as an optional package, [code]sentry-godot-crash-reporter-<version>.zip[/code]. To use it, unpack the package into your project folder and set [member enabled] to [code]true[/code]. No other configuration is needed. To learn more, visit [url=https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/godot/configuration/crash-reporter/]Crash Reporter documentation[/url]. [b]Platform support:[/b] Linux and Windows. Has no effect on other platforms. [b]Note:[/b] The SDK skips the crash reporter on headless display servers.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the SDK launches the crash reporter executable after a crash. Set its location with [member path].

Path to the crash reporter executable: absolute, [code]user://[/code], or relative to the game executable's directory. At initialization, the SDK loads this value from the [code]sentry/crash_reporter/path_<platform>_<arch>[/code] project setting for the running platform and architecture. The SDK looks for a file with this name beside the game executable first, then at the path as given. If neither exists, the SDK prints a warning and continues without the crash reporter.
